args.script:
cat > count_lines.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
count=0
for file in dir1/*.txt dir2/*.txt; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        lines=$(wc -l < "$file")
        count=$((count + lines))
    fi
done
echo $count
EOF
chmod +x count_lines.sh
